boundaryZh: 本文件只定义 EcoScreen 早筛可用性的文献需求、字段覆盖和下一步接入建议，不改变候选材料底层评分算法。
boundaryEn: This file defines literature-derived EcoScreen usability requirements, field coverage, and next data-ingestion suggestions. It does not change the underlying candidate scoring algorithm.

requirements.basisLabelZh: Wilmer 大规模 MOF 筛选、Bae/Snurr CO₂ 吸附评价、吸附剂多指标排序研究
requirements.basisLabelEn: Wilmer large-scale MOF screening; Bae/Snurr CO2 adsorbent evaluation; multi-criteria adsorbent ranking
requirements.needZh: 气体分离候选不能只看容量，需要把吸附量、选择性、工作容量和可比条件拆开检查。
requirements.needEn: Gas-separation candidates cannot be judged by uptake alone; uptake, selectivity, working capacity, and comparable conditions must be checked separately.
requirements.nextDataZh: 接入同一气体对、温度、压力和进料比例下的 GCMC/IAST 或实验吸附字段。
requirements.nextDataEn: Ingest GCMC/IAST or experimental adsorption fields under the same gas pair, temperature, pressure, and feed ratio.

requirements.basisLabelZh: MOF 基 CO₂ 吸附剂能耗评价与 CO₂ 吸附材料评价综述
requirements.basisLabelEn: MOF-based CO2 adsorbent energy-performance evaluation and CO2 adsorbent evaluation review
requirements.needZh: 工作容量、吸附热、解吸条件和循环稳定性决定吸附剂是否可能具有过程可用性。
requirements.needEn: Working capacity, heat of adsorption, desorption conditions, and cyclic stability determine whether an adsorbent may be process-usable.
requirements.nextDataZh: 补充吸附热、解吸压力/温度、循环容量保持率和过程能耗 proxy。
requirements.nextDataEn: Add heat of adsorption, desorption pressure/temperature, cyclic capacity retention, and process-energy proxies.

requirements.labelZh: 水稳定性与运行稳定性
requirements.basisLabelZh: Burtch/Jasuja/Walton 关于 MOF 水稳定性与吸附的综述
requirements.basisLabelEn: Burtch/Jasuja/Walton review on MOF water stability and adsorption
requirements.needZh: 湿气、烟道气或水相环境下，水稳定性和热稳定性应作为应用门槛，而不是普通装饰字段。
requirements.needEn: Under humid, flue-gas, or aqueous conditions, water and thermal stability should be application gates rather than decorative fields.
requirements.nextDataZh: 接入水暴露、湿气循环、PXRD 保持、吸附保持率和热重分析字段。
requirements.nextDataEn: Ingest water exposure, humidity cycling, PXRD retention, uptake retention, and TGA fields.

requirements.labelZh: 绿色合成与 LCA 准备度
requirements.basisLabelZh: 绿色 MOF 合成综述、MOF 生命周期评价研究、可持续 CCS 材料基础与 ISO LCA 标准
requirements.basisLabelEn: Green MOF synthesis review, MOF LCA study, sustainable CCS materials basis, and ISO LCA standards
requirements.needZh: 绿色筛选需要知道溶剂、温度、时间、产率、活化溶剂、功能单位和清单边界。
requirements.needEn: Green screening needs solvent, temperature, time, yield, activation solvent, functional unit, and inventory boundary.
requirements.nextDataZh: 接入每个候选的合成路线、溶剂/活化剂、产率、能耗、功能单位和 LCI 来源。
requirements.nextDataEn: Ingest each candidate's synthesis route, solvent/activation solvent, yield, energy use, functional unit, and LCI source.

requirements.basisLabelZh: USGS 关键矿物、欧盟关键原料清单与可持续 MOF-CCS 材料研究
requirements.basisLabelEn: USGS critical minerals, EU critical raw materials, and sustainable MOF-CCS materials study
requirements.needZh: 金属价格、关键原料标签、毒性关注和前驱体可得性应被单独标记，避免混入性能分。
requirements.needEn: Metal price, critical-material flags, toxicity concern, and precursor availability should be marked separately rather than mixed into performance score.
requirements.nextDataZh: 用可追溯的 USGS/供应商/区域价格和安全数据表替换临时金属成本值。
requirements.nextDataEn: Replace provisional metal-cost values with traceable USGS, supplier, regional price, and safety-data sources.

requirements.basisLabelZh: 结构化高通量化学数据建模思路与 CRITIC 客观赋权方法
requirements.basisLabelEn: Structured high-throughput chemistry modeling and CRITIC objective weighting
requirements.needZh: 每条候选记录必须区分文献、实验、模拟、演示和待核验字段，排序解释需要可回到来源。
requirements.needEn: Each candidate record must distinguish literature, experiment, simulation, demonstration, and pending fields; ranking explanations should trace back to sources.
requirements.nextDataZh: 补充 DOI、字段位置、实验标签、外部测试标记和 benchmark eligibility。
requirements.nextDataEn: Add DOI, field location, experimental labels, external-test markers, and benchmark eligibility.

requirements.basisLabelZh: 几何-电子催化热区、MOF 腔内/表面活性解释与分子指纹到验证的工作流
requirements.basisLabelEn: Geometric-electronic catalytic hot spots, MOF in-cavity/surface activity interpretation, and molecular-fingerprint-to-validation workflow
requirements.needZh: 若 EcoScreen 结果要进入有机酸/催化链路，需要活性位点、路径证据、水相稳定和反应条件字段。
requirements.needEn: If EcoScreen results enter the Organic Acid / Catalysis workflow, active-site, pathway-evidence, aqueous-stability, and reaction-condition fields are required.
requirements.nextDataZh: 接入有机酸路径证据、DFT/实验活性位点、反应条件和水相稳定性记录。
requirements.nextDataEn: Ingest organic-acid pathway evidence, DFT/experimental active-site records, reaction conditions, and aqueous-stability records.
